Australia violated rights of Indigenous islanders by failing to act on the #ClimateCrisis and should pay compensation, a UN body ruled.

Torres Strait islanders say rising sea levels destroyed crops and graveyards, and the ruling may "open doors" for other low-lying islands. https://t.co/cIsEMKj99T

The Horn of Africa is already facing its worst drought in decades, with 22 million people facing starvation.

Rising heat waves may:
▪️ Also cause "large-scale suffering" in the Sahel, South Asia, Southwest Asia
▪️ Unequally impact nations least responsible for the #climatecrisis https://t.co/9V0iuoqyeR
